findings.title: CRITICAL: Design Scope Does Not Address Requirements Document
findings.problem: The design only addresses gate state management and team member capabilities. It completely omits 11 critical/high priority security requirements from 01-requirements.md including CRIT-001 (IDOR in QR lookup), CRIT-002 (PayHere payment security), HIGH-001 through HIGH-012.
findings.concreteFix: Create additional design documents that address the security requirements specified in 01-requirements.md. The scope gap must be resolved before implementation.

findings.title: CRITICAL: Payment Security Completely Missing
findings.problem: Requirements mandate comprehensive PayHere webhook validation including amount verification and idempotency. The existing payment.js lacks expected vs callback amount validation, has no idempotency protection, and does not verify merchant_id against configured value.
findings.concreteFix: Add payment security section: verify merchant_id matches configured value, validate expectedAmount === callbackAmount exactly, implement idempotency by checking order.paymentStatus before processing, and add race condition protection using MongoDB transactions.

findings.title: Unverified Assumption: requireScopedEvent Does Not Exist
findings.problem: Design states 'The workspace endpoint already uses requireScopedEvent' but grep_search confirmed this middleware does not exist in backend/src/middleware/ or backend/src/routes/organiser.js.
findings.concreteFix: Either create requireScopedEvent middleware in auth.js, or reference correct middleware name (existing code uses requireEventAccess). Update design to use verified middleware references.

findings.title: Unverified Assumption: optionalProtect Does Not Exist
findings.problem: Design claims optionalProtect is exported from '../middleware/auth'. Verified auth.js exports do NOT include optionalProtect.
findings.concreteFix: Remove reference to optionalProtect, or add it to auth.js: const optionalProtect = async (req, res, next) => { if (!req.headers.authorization) return next(); return protect(req, res, next); };

findings.title: QR Token Lookup Event Scope Missing
findings.problem: Requirements CRIT-001 requires event scope for all QR lookups. Endpoint GET /attendees/by-qr/:qrToken exists and lacks event validation. Audit report explicitly flags this as security vulnerability.
findings.concreteFix: Add event scope validation to by-qr endpoint: fetch attendee by qrToken, validate provided eventId matches attendee.event, verify userHasEventAccess(req.user, attendee.event), return 403 if unauthorized.

findings.title: MainOrganiser Isolation Incomplete in Existing Code
findings.problem: Existing requireEventAccess allows MainOrganiser to bypass ALL event checks (canonicalRole === ROLES.MAIN_ORGANISER returns next()). Requirements HIGH-001 state MainOrganiser can ONLY access explicitly assigned events.
findings.concreteFix: Modify requireEventAccess: remove MainOrganiser from bypass condition, only MAIN_ADMIN bypasses. MainOrganiser must pass event assignment check like other non-admin roles.

findings.title: Token Blocklist Missing (HIGH-002)
findings.problem: Requirements mandate token invalidation on logout. Existing logout only clears refresh token from DB. Access tokens (JWT with 24h TTL) cannot be revoked until expiry.
findings.concreteFix: Add TokenBlocklist model with jti and expiry. On logout, add token jti to blocklist. In protect middleware, check blocklist before verifying token. Set TTL to match token expiry.

findings.title: Login Generic Error Missing (HIGH-009)
findings.problem: Requirements state login should not reveal account existence. Existing login likely distinguishes between 'user not found' and 'wrong password'.
findings.concreteFix: Use consistent error message: 'Invalid credentials' for both missing user and wrong password. Use constant-time bcrypt comparison to prevent timing attacks.

findings.title: Gate Duplicate Validation - Implementation Details Missing
findings.problem: Design proposes backend validation but doesn't specify exact code location in organiser.js or handle case-insensitive comparison comprehensively.
findings.concreteFix: Document exact line numbers for insertion. Use toLowerCase() for case-insensitive duplicate detection. Ensure consistent with existing gate extraction logic.

findings.title: Scope Filtering Logic - Incomplete User Role Handling
findings.problem: Filter uses ROLES.SUB_ORGANISER without normalizeRole(). Role normalization may result in 'sub_organiser' vs 'SubOrganiser' mismatch.
findings.concreteFix: Apply normalizeRole() to user role before comparison: const userRole = normalizeRole(req.user.role);
